survey: A classic straw broom floating diagonally on an icon card, with no ground plane, so floating is normal icon framing. Main parts: (1) a straight, round wooden handle with a rounded knob cap at the top end, angled up and to the right; (2) a tight straw collar at the lower end, where the handle goes cleanly into the bundle; (3) a red cord binding wrapped two or three times around the collar, cinching the straw to the handle; (4) a straw head that flares out below the binding into a fan with an uneven bottom edge, seen mostly from the front and three-quarter side. The cord is drawn as snug wraps, with no free ends hanging in the air. The handle is the same width from end to end and stays round. The straw spreads the way bound fibers would. Every part joins where it should, and the broom could sweep.
